name: Stage Mode
objective: Face waves of various fans and bosses. The stage ends once the player's defeat of the stage's final boss, which appears after 20 minutes.
completion_rule: The stage ends and the next stage unlocks once the final boss is defeated. A completion bonus of HoloCoins is granted, calculated as floor((haluBonusCoins + enemyDefeated) * 0.25 + clearAmount), where clearAmount is 3000 (Stage 1), 5000 (Stage 2), 7500 (Stage 3), 10000 (Stage 4), 15000 (Stage 5), 5000 (Stage 1H), 15000 (Stage 2H), 30000 (Stage 3H), 50000 (Stage 4H).
coverage_note: Source: Stage page 'Game modes / Stage Mode'. Main bosses appear every 10 minutes and mini-bosses every 2 minutes (Enemy page). A green check mark records a completed stage per character. UNKNOWN: no separate standalone 'Stage Mode' wiki page exists; this content comes from the Stage article.

name: Endless Mode
objective: Face waves of fans. Unlike Stage Mode, the waves keep coming until the player loses, with fan stats scaling up over time.
completion_rule: No completion condition. The run ends when the player is defeated.
coverage_note: Source: Stage page 'Game modes / Endless Mode'. UNKNOWN: no separate standalone 'Endless Mode' wiki page exists; this content comes from the Stage article.

name: Hardcore (Endless Mode modifier)
objective: Self-imposed Endless Mode challenge, toggled on or off for free in the Shop Upgrades menu.
completion_rule: No completion condition; the run ends when the player is defeated. The player has only 1 HP the entire time, and the amount of Score earned increases based on how long the player survived. Hardcore does not affect the amount of HoloCoins earned.
coverage_note: Source: Stage page 'Game modes / Endless Mode / Hardcore'. UNKNOWN: documented as a toggle within Endless Mode rather than a standalone mode; no separate wiki page. A known scoring bug is documented: finishing at exactly 9:59:59 yields a higher score than 10:00:00 because the game uses visible minutes.

name: Time Mode
objective: Defeat a set number of fans as quickly as possible. All upgrades are standardized at the start and certain items are disabled.
completion_rule: For the only documented Time Stage (Time Stage 1 - Concert Stage) the battle ends immediately after 4000 enemies are killed, even if enemies remain on screen.
coverage_note: Source: Stage page 'Game modes / Time Mode' plus Time Stage 1 - Concert Stage. Mode is hidden until Time Stage 1 is unlocked. Restrictions: Collabs and Super Collabs disabled, Super Items unobtainable, Fandom and G. Rank bonuses disabled, Shop Upgrades standardized, all character skills unlocked at level 1, no Holo House meal buffs. UNKNOWN: no standalone 'Time Mode' page exists; the enemy count is documented as 4000 only for Time Stage 1.
